english.title: Systematically fail to provide a mandatory travel concession
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was an operator of a passenger transport service, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE NAME..), that failed to provide a concession, consisting of a waiver of the fare for a journey, to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), to whom a current statutory travel concession permit had been issued and was produced whilst travelling on an eligible journey on an eligible service
english.legislation: Contrary to section 148 of the Transport Act 2000.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
operator systematically
failed to comply
with the obligation under
section 145A(1) / 145B(1) of the Transport Act 2000

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Proceedings may only be instituted by a travel concession authority, or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions; and any authority who would not otherwise have power to bring such proceedings shall accordingly have that power (section 148(3)).
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant was an operator of a passenger transport service, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE NAME..), that failed to provide a concession, consisting of a waiver of the fare for a journey, to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), to whom a current statutory travel concession permit had been issued and was produced whilst travelling on an eligible journey on an eligible service.
